A restoration contractor and an interior designer have five days to show off one old house together without trashing each other.

Grant restores old houses and thinks anything beige is a cry for help. Malik designs interiors and thinks Grant's century-old trim looks tired. Neither is the other's boss, and the Delgados hired them both. On 土曜日 they have to present one restored 1912 bungalow at the open house, fairly and together. The reader decides how Grant shares credit, keeps the clients' trust, and whether he asks Malik out once the invoice clears.
The Delgados' listing agent, who has to keep both of them on schedule and on speaking terms.
